text: {"lessons":["Recent gains and losses have not reliably signaled what comes next, so I should avoid trying to time the market from short-term price moves.","I should make trades based on my overall allocation, goals, and risk tolerance, rather than selling a stock solely because it has risen far above my average cost.","Doing nothing can be a deliberate choice, but I should still review my portfolio periodically and rebalance if its risks or concentration no longer fit my plan."]}
